full_prompt_en: A square surreal illustrated painting crowds a group of angular-faced men around a giant single eye set into a yellow wall. The background is dark brown brick, but the central vertical field glows dull gold and holds an enormous turquoise iris under a heavy pink lid. Short dark rays radiate outward from that eye, making it the fixed center of the image. On the left, several men in brimmed hats and coats overlap tightly from the upper corner to the bottom edge. Their long pointed noses and wary side glances form a chain that leads toward the eye and across to the figures at right. A man in a warm brown coat and scarf stands just left of center; another in a blue-gray coat and tall hat leans behind him. On the right, a man in a gray knit cap faces left above a lower man wearing a small dark hat and teal coat. The lower right man holds a compact square device with knobs and colored vertical slots between both hands at the bottom center. His exaggerated profile, furrowed cheeks, and narrowed eye make him appear intent on it. Coats in teal, slate, olive, rust, and mustard form broad adjoining color areas beneath the small animated faces. The illustration uses dense tiny strokes and stippled shading to round forms while keeping their silhouettes sharply defined. Light seems to come from the golden wall and the large eye, warming the faces nearest the center; the brick corners and overlapping coats stay dark. There is no open horizon or readable lettering, only a compressed theatrical interior of bodies, wall, and gaze. The overall composition is claustrophobic and wry, its human profiles orbiting the watchful central emblem.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实插画式绘画让一群棱角分明的男子围在黄色墙上的一只巨大独眼旁。背景是深棕砖墙，但中央竖向色域发出暗金色光，厚重粉红眼睑下嵌着巨大的青绿虹膜。短深色线条从眼周向外放射，使它成为画面固定中心。左侧，几名戴檐帽、穿外套的男子从上角到下缘紧密重叠。他们细长尖鼻和警惕的侧眼形成一道视线链，指向巨眼并越过画面望向右侧人物。一名穿暖棕外套和围巾的男子站在中央偏左处，另一名穿蓝灰外套、戴高帽的男子从后探出。右侧，一名戴灰色针织帽的男子在上方朝左，下方另有一名戴小深帽、穿青绿外套的男子。右下人物双手握着一台有旋钮和彩色竖槽的紧凑方形装置，装置处在下部中央。他夸张的侧脸、起皱的面颊和眯起的眼睛让他显得专注于手中之物。青绿、石板色、橄榄绿、锈红和芥末黄外套在小而生动的面孔下方形成大片相接色域。插画以密集短笔痕与点状明暗塑圆形体，同时让剪影保持锐利。光似乎来自金色墙面和大眼睛，使靠中央的面庞变暖；砖墙角落与层叠外套仍然深暗。画里没有开阔地平线或可读文字，只有身体、墙面和凝视压缩成的戏剧性内部空间。整体构图拥挤而带反讽意味，人物侧脸围绕中央注视的符号运转。
style_prompt_en: The illustrated painting uses tightly interlocked shapes, exaggerated curved profiles, and a dense surface of small stippled marks. Muted teal, rusty red, ocher, olive, and smoky gray sit against dark brown, with one dull golden vertical zone carrying the strongest light. Forms are rounded by close-set hatching and granular tonal shifts, yet the outer edges stay crisp enough to separate crowded layers. Long diagonals and projecting points interrupt larger soft curves, giving the composition a nervous, humorous rhythm. Space is deliberately compressed: repeated overlaps replace a deep vanishing point, and the dark perimeter presses inward around a brighter central focus. Directional warm light catches selected planes while deep shadow remains between adjacent masses. A large simplified focal shape anchors many smaller directional gazes and marks, making the crowded arrangement coherent. The overall finish feels hand-rendered, theatrical, and slightly uncanny, with patterned shading and strong silhouette design working together.
style_prompt_zh: 这类插画式绘画使用紧密咬合的形体、夸张弯曲的轮廓和密集细小点痕表面。灰青、锈红、赭黄、橄榄绿与烟灰色置于深棕底前，一道暗金竖向色域承载最强的光。密排线条与颗粒状明度变化塑圆形体，外缘却保持足够清晰，以分开拥挤层次。长斜线和突出的尖角打断更大的柔软曲线，让构图有紧张而幽默的节奏。空间刻意压缩：反复遮叠替代深处灭点，暗色外围朝较亮中央焦点挤入。定向暖光触及选定平面，相邻团块之间保持浓重阴影。一个大型简化焦点锚住许多较小的方向性目光和痕迹，使拥挤安排仍然连贯。整体完成面有手绘感、舞台感与轻微怪诞气息，图案化明暗和有力剪影设计共同起作用。
theme_en: A crowded surreal street scene gathered around a giant watching eye
theme_zh: 众人围在巨大凝视之眼旁的超现实街景
name: PJ Crook
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
